question: M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). P is sitting fourth to the right of N. Q is sitting third to the left of O. M is sitting to the immediate right of Q. R is sitting to the immediate right of N. How many people are sitting between P and S when counted from the left of S?
solution:
Given:

M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Q is sitting third to the left of O.

M is sitting to the immediate right of Q.

R is sitting to the immediate right of N. 

P is sitting fourth to the right of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bd15b5bb757d67f270905ae93cde5b905f5ac2c3d91155be62f204b637502df.png] 

Thus, 1 people are sitting between P and S when counted from the left of S.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
